tasks.title: Keep recurring task identities readable beside row actions
tasks.body:
Goal:
Keep recurring task identities readable beside action groups.

Current behavior:
The current768-pixel hydrated Daily screenshot places task title, reference and Notes in a glyph-wide left column. An auto-width action column consumes almost all width despite no outer horizontal overflow. Habits use the same raw task-list layout and require independent qualification.

Desired behavior:
Allow task identity and action columns to share readable width, stacking when required. Preserve native Notes, exact action names, per-task occurrence inputs and original review fences.

Touch:
- `src/Habitica.WebApp/wwwroot/css/app.css`
- `tests/browser-qualification/ux-ui-workspace-names-journey.mjs`
- `tests/browser-qualification/ux-ui-recurring-row-journey.mjs`
- `tests/browser-qualification/ux-ui-adapters.json`

Implementation constraints:
Scope layout to shared raw task-list rows. No font/zoom reduction, hidden content, action removal, mutation or recurrence changes. Existing local synthetic execution authorization applies. Physical devices and assistive technology remain unqualified.

Validation:
The retained screenshot/HTML and invisible open Notes content establish the failing rendered regression. Preserve existing exact-record component checks. Require available ordinary-word width and visible native disclosure content on actual Habits and Dailies across all declared schemes, widths and text sizes. Compare selected Daily date ink and unchanged journals.
